notes.title: Estelaroid: Escape Room is Out Today!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

We are over the moon to share the big news: Estelaroid: Escape Room, our highly anticipated sci-fi adventure escape room game, is now officially launched and ready for you to play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508610/Estelaroid_Escape_Room/

[b]Wha's New[/b]
Prepare yourselves for an edge-of-your-seat experience filled with tension, enigmas, and the unknown. With enhanced lighting effects and a variety of rooms spread across different levels, we are giving you a glimpse of the vast universe that awaits. We trust this will showcase the ambience and interactive experience we have crafted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367904/d89aee6c94713360fdd887d7eb53efdce9c1a95e.gif[/img]

[b]Game Highlights[/b]
We’re excited for you to discover the key highlights of Estelaroid: Escape Room:
[list]
[*] A richly detailed science fiction universe
[*] Mind-bending puzzles that challenge and reward
[*] A captivating narrative that pulls you into the action
[*] An array of levels and spaces to uncover
[*] A thrilling race against time to break free before you're sucked into a black hole
[/list]
We are eager for you to try the full game and share your thoughts! Your feedback is invaluable to us.
[previewyoutube=3Hs_rLH1z5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Questions?[/b]
Should you have any inquiries about the game, don't hesitate to reach out. We're here to engage and assist.

With gratitude,
Your support is the cornerstone of our efforts. As we continue to refine and expand Estelaroid: Escape Room, you can look forward to ongoing updates and insights. Keep an eye out for more news!

notes.title: Estelaroid: Escape Room Release Delayed
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

Today, we’re reaching out to share some important news regarding our much-anticipated title, "Estelaroid: Escape Room."

We've encountered a few unexpected challenges that have pushed back our timeline. While we are eager to get the game into your hands, quality and player experience remain our top priorities, and we believe it's crucial to address these issues to ensure the best experience possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508610/Estelaroid_Escape_Room/

We understand that delays can be disappointing, and we are just as eager to see our game come to life as you are. However, we are committed to using this time to enhance gameplay, squash bugs, and polish each puzzle to perfection.

We'll keep you updated with our progress and, in the meantime, we appreciate your patience and support. Your enthusiasm fuels our work, and we can't wait to deliver a stellar escape room adventure that will be worth the wait!

Stay tuned, and thank you for being the best part of Estelaroid!

Clear skies and happy gaming,

The Estelaroid Dev Team

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Update to Demo, What To Expect From The Release
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that Estelaroid: Escape Room, our upcoming sci-fi adventure escape room game, will be fully released on November 8th. 

In the meantime, we have been in the laboratory working and making some changes. 

[b]Changes to the demo[/b]
We're excited to announce that we've made a number of changes to the Estelaroid: Escape Room demo, and it's now available for re-download!

[b]What to expect[/b]
Expect a thriller of gameplay, suspense and mystery. We've added new lighting and different rooms on different levels. This is just a small taste of what the full game will have to offer, but we hope it gives you a good idea of the atmosphere and gameplay we're going for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367904/9b3b2ff42f16d99790e785c0649645fc50e6d6b3.gif[/img]

Expect 6 exciting levels and floors with suspense and 3-4 hours of gameplay depending on how fast you are! You ready for the challenge? 

[b]Key Features[/b]
Here are some of the key features of Estelaroid: Escape Room:
[list]
[*] Immersive science fiction setting
[*] Challenging puzzles
[*] Engaging storyline
[*] Multiple levels and rooms to explore
[*] Race against time to escape before the ship reaches the black hole
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the updated demo! Please let us know what you think in the comments below.
We're also happy to answer any questions you have about the game.
Thanks for your support!
We're always working hard to improve Estelaroid: Escape Room, and we'll continue to release updates and devlogs in the future. Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Playing Estelaroid Demo
notes.notes: You are in a spaceship, alone. The crew disappeared, and the ship quickly approaches a black hole. In this science fiction Escape Room, you must put your wits to the test and thus repair your spaceship before being trapped forever in the universe.

notes.title: Estelaroid Demo Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Dear players:

Version 0.1.1 has already been released, this is the new list of changes and new features:

- Hint system for puzzles
- Mouse sensitivity system
- System to keep the keys in the inventory
- Notification system when there is an incorrect code
- Removed some stage elements that could confuse players about interaction
- Performance optimization
- New main menu

For suggestions or bug fixes, you can join our Discord! We'll be alert. Thank you all!

https://discord.com/invite/Tgg4689Cha
